choose.when:
SELECT 'production' AS "sourceType", id AS "sourceId", logistics_date AS "saleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", COALESCE(logistics_actual_qty, actual_qty, order_qty) AS "qtyText", client_code AS "clientCode", product_code AS "productCode" FROM production_schedule WHERE logistics_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND ship_confirmed = 1
AND (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientName} || '%'
choose.otherwise:
SELECT 'logistics' AS "sourceType", id AS "sourceId", schedule_date AS "saleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = logistics_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = logistics_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", COALESCE(actual_qty, order_qty) AS "qtyText", client_code AS "clientCode", product_code AS "productCode" FROM logistics_schedule WHERE schedule_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND ship_confirmed = 1
AND (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = logistics_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) ILIKE '%' || #{clientName} || '%'

mapper.select: SELECT source_type AS "sourceType", source_id AS "sourceId" FROM sales_record WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN p.spec IS NOT NULL AND p.spec != '' THEN p.name || '(' || p.spec || ')' ELSE COALESCE(p.name, '') END AS "productName", (SELECT COALESCE(pr.current_price, pr.total_price) FROM pricing pr WHERE pr.product_code = p.code LIMIT 1) AS "unitPrice" FROM products p ORDER BY p.code
SELECT client_code FROM clients WHERE name = #{clientName} AND client_code IS NOT NULL AND client_code != '' ORDER BY client_code LIMIT 1

SELECT code FROM products WHERE name = #{displayName} OR (spec IS NOT NULL AND spec != '' AND (name || '(' || spec || ')' = #{displayName} OR name || ' (' || spec || ')' = #{displayName})) ORDER BY code LIMIT 1
